criteria.evidence: All five sections (Intent, Business goal, Guiding rules, Capabilities, Scope (In / Out)) are present and substantive, e.g. 'Out: building the cart, checkout and order records themselves...'
'A sale won back means a real order. Success is counted by reminded carts that end in an order... because sending more messages is easy and says nothing about whether owners kept their sales.'
Guiding rules, Capabilities and Scope are discrete bullets, each stating the point and its reason. Intent and Business goal are short paragraphs, as the guidance asks.
A domain has no parent doc.
'This domain exists to turn more of those abandoned carts into finished orders... a reminder reaches only someone the shop may contact, and never often enough to become spam.'
